clause.text: A list item that starts with `[ ]` or `[x]` (or `[X]`), then a space and text, is a task list item, as on GitHub (GFM's task list items): a checkbox, unticked or ticked, that a click does not change, then the text alone, no bullet: "- [ ] Tag the release" is an unticked box and "Tag the release"

scenes.caption: code-style's SKILL.md says "- [ ] Tag the release", "- [x] Write the notes": a box, unticked then ticked, and the text alone

clause.text: in a loose list, the box is in the item's first paragraph

scenes.caption: A loose list, a blank line between its items: each box is in its item's paragraph

clause.text: `[ ]` with no text after it, `[y]`, `[x]text` or an escaped `\[ ]` is text

scenes.caption: "- [ ]" alone, "- [y] Ship", "- [x]Ship" and "- \[ ] Ship" are text: no box
